wrist_ft.order: Fx Fy Fz Tx Ty Tz

object_wrench.order: Fx Fy Fz Tx Ty Tz

tactile.units: N per angular bin, not pressure

planar_tactile: 2 pads x (normal magnitude, pad x shear, pad y shear) x 4 x 4; N/bin; no interpolation
contact_state: 2 force-bearing contact counts, one per pad

expert_reference.positive_direction: right-hand rule about world +y; panel +x edge moves down
expert_reference.meaning: additional cooperative torque above independent baseline support
expert_reference.total_reference: baseline object-level reference plus cooperative wrench; unavailable without allocator

expert_design.proposed_objective: goal tracking + human effort + robot effort + torque smoothness
expert_design.implementation_status: interface only; weights, optimality and reachable references unvalidated

controller.executed_actuator_commands: actual four pad motor forces, N
controller.executed_virtual_drive_wrenches: actual bounded external drives at root origins, world, N / Nm
controller.realized_object_wrench: measured contact sum acting on panel, world about COM
controller.fixed_fixture_reaction: not applicable: each root is freejoint, no world fixture constraint

observation_augmentation: derived wrench/state/contact fields only; no privileged goal/force/label
